summary.one_liner: FTXUI is a C++ library for building functional-style terminal user interfaces with layout, styling, canvas drawing, and interactive widgets.
summary.what_it_does: The library has three modules: screen (low-level rendering of colors, pixels, and terminal output), dom (hierarchical Element layout using hbox, vbox, gridbox, and flexbox, plus decorators like border, color, and bold), and component (interactive widgets such as Radiobox, Checkbox, Input, Toggle, Slider, Menu, ResizableSplit, Dropdown, and Tab, which react to keyboard, mouse, and resize events). It supports UTF-8 and fullwidth characters, paragraph text wrapping, tables, and a Canvas that draws with braille, block, or simple characters. The README shows a short example that renders a layout to a screen and prints it. Build options include CMake FetchContent, Bazel, and Meson, and it is also listed in several package managers.
use_cases: build a terminal dashboard or resource monitor in C++
create interactive text-mode forms with inputs, checkboxes, and menus
draw charts or graphics in a terminal using braille or block characters
make terminal games or animations in C++
add a TUI to a command-line tool
how_to_run: Add FTXUI to a CMake project with FetchContent_Declare using GIT_REPOSITORY and GIT_TAG v7.0.3, then FetchContent_MakeAvailable(ftxui)
Or in Bazel, add bazel_dep(name = "ftxui", version = "7.0.3") to MODULE.bazel and depend on @ftxui//:ftxui
Or build with Meson: meson setup builddir; ninja -C builddir
notable: Supports C++20 modules and an amalgamated single-header/source build
Cross-platform: Linux and macOS as main targets, with WebAssembly and Windows support noted
Includes a gallery of example programs and a list of projects built with it
caveats: Linux/macOS are the main target; Windows support comes from contributors
Build instructions for some packaging routes are in separate docs (e.g., Meson details in doc/installation_meson.md)
